nodes.evidence: MSan crash backtrace frame #4 (ReadLABELImage label.c:127) — the LABEL coder hands the attacker-controlled label text to InterpretImageProperties for '%[...]' escape interpretation.

MSan allocation ('uninitialized value created by a heap allocation') stack: AcquireQuantumMemory memory.c:541 <- ConstantString string.c:713 <- SetImageProperty property.c:4574 <- SignatureImage signature.c:555 <- GetMagickPropertyLetter property.c:2789. Exactly-sized 'signature' property KEY buffer that is later over-read.
MSan crash backtrace frame #3 (property.c:3944) — the glob branch iterates property keys and calls GlobExpression(key, pattern='*{,', MagickTrue) with key = the exactly-sized 'signature' buffer.

Line 524 'expression+=strlen(target);' is the exact statement the fix (commit cfd2824) replaces with 'expression+=MagickMin(strlen(expression),strlen(target));'. Same PoC: vul crashes (exit 77), fix runs clean (exit 0) => vul_crashes && fix_clean confirm the unclamped advance at 524 is the root cause. The over-advanced cursor is then read at token.c:568 (crash frame #2).

MSan crash backtrace frame #0 (GetNextUTFCode token-private.h:117:9): code=(int)(*text++) reads an uninitialized byte from the over-advanced 'expression' cursor; MSan reports use-of-uninitialized-value. Reached via GetUTFCode token-private.h:141 (frame #1) from GlobExpression token.c:568 (frame #2).

Byte-copy of the braced escape into 'pattern' (yielding '#' then '*{,'). Not present in either ASan stack; witnessing the exact line needs a source-coverage rebuild (deferred on emulated host). Execution strongly implied because both downstream effects (signature-property creation and GlobExpression with a glob pattern) are witnessed.

edges.evidence: MSan allocation stack (string.c:713) and the crash stack (token-private.h:117) name the same uninitialized object; the uninit READ happens after the allocation — the alloc->use order MSan itself reports.

edges.evidence: The uninit read at the sink is caused by the unclamped advance at 524; clamping it (fix) removes the crash, and the vul read occurs at token.c:568 immediately after the brace-case advance.

root_cause_criterion.evidence: The bug is a missing clamp on the brace-alternation cursor advance: at the vulnerable commit GlobExpression does 'expression+=strlen(target)' (token.c:524) with no bound on the remaining length of 'expression', pushing the cursor past the NUL of the exactly-sized 'signature' key buffer; the subsequent GetUTFCode reads uninitialized memory. The fix adds the MagickMin clamp shown in 'condition'. Confirmed by patch differential: vul crashes, fix clean.
root_cause_criterion.alternative_framing_note: Class is MSan use-of-uninitialized-value (CWE-457); equivalently framed as lifetime/use_before_init on object 'destination' (the exactly-sized 'signature' key) — first_write at ConstantString string.c:713, use at GetNextUTFCode token-private.h:117 after the out-of-bounds advance. The bounds_check shape is used here because the patch-added guard is literally a bounds clamp on the advance.
